Before your son becomes a man, teach him these. And don't miss the one that's not on the list. 🎖️

Asher earns a badge for each one:
✅ Keep your word. His promises should mean something.
✅ Respect everyone, especially people who can't do anything for him. "Thank you, Mr. Joe!"
✅ Control his anger. Real strength knows when to pause. ⏸️
✅ Take responsibility. No excuses. Own it.
✅ Handle rejection, even when he's "not good enough."
✅ Work for what he wants. Discipline takes him where motivation can't. 🏀
✅ Ask for help. It doesn't make him weak.
✅ Love his family.
✅ Stay kind, even when the world laughs.

But the one NOT on the list? He's loved before he earns a single thing. ❤️ Research finds that when love seems to depend on the score, kids' joy in winning doesn't last (Assor, Roth & Deci, Journal of Personality, 2004).

Before Jesus did a single miracle, the Father said: "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased." Matthew 3:17 (ESV) 🙏 Then Jesus lived the perfect life, died for our sins and rose again.

At eighteen, the world tests him. The rejection letter says "no." But he isn't shaken, because at five, his mom told him: "I love you because you're my son." ❤️ "Never good enough" is just worry talking.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
